comment: What the release chain's source-admission stage requires green on a tagged commit.
Only release admission (bin/build-admit.py) reads this file. The GitHub ruleset (main-protection)
is the only required list for merges; no job or test compares the two, so keep this list to the
integration_id 15368 is GitHub Actions: it pins each context to check runs produced
by Actions, so a check run with the same name from any other app does not satisfy it.
scope: 'push' means the check runs on main commits and release
admission requires it green on the exact tagged SHA; 'pull_request'
means it only ever runs on PRs, so admission requires it green on
the head of the merged PR that produced the tagged commit (F02).
promotion_checks are the full suite (REQ-CI-007-AC2): admission requires each green on the exact tagged commit for a
release-candidate tag only, as a schedule or dispatch run of the one workflow file bin/build-admit.py binds it to.
